source_disagreements.topic: XRP ETF flows versus holdings deltas
source_disagreements.source_a: Alpha Finance: five-ticker flow series, $0 on 2026-11-06, +$8.4M over 7 sessions and +$45.9M over 30 sessions.
source_disagreements.source_b: XRP Insights prior methodology artifact: seven-fund holdings-delta proxy -812,529 XRP over 2026-11-02 through 2026-11-06, including index rebalancing and fees.
source_disagreements.reason: Different fund universes, metrics, windows and data methods. Neither is issuer-confirmed cash creation/redemption evidence. Alpha Finance states flows are backward-looking and may settle with lag.

source_disagreements.topic: Ripple National Trust Bank final OCC approval
source_disagreements.source_a: Ripple's 2026-10-26 press release says final OCC approval was received.
source_disagreements.source_b: The official OCC release located in this review is the 2025-12-12 conditional approval; no direct OCC final-approval notice was located.
source_disagreements.reason: Issuer statement is not a substitute for a regulator final notice; absence from the reviewed OCC material is not proof that approval did not occur.

source_disagreements.source_a: Circle Q3 2026 distribution costs to Coinbase: $331.3M for Q3 and $986.6M for nine months.
source_disagreements.source_b: Coinbase Q3 2026 stablecoin revenue: $306.905M for Q3 and $904.487M for nine months.
source_disagreements.reason: Different issuer/distributor accounting line items and contract economics; do not net or label as a direct profit split.

indirect_channels: Potential XRP fee demand from XRPL activity
Potential bridge-liquidity use in specific payment paths
Potential retail XRP acquisitions through vouchers and reward conversion
xrp_impact_assessment.indirect_channel_evidence: No chain-specific RLUSD transaction, DEX pathfinding, bridge-volume, XRP fee-burn, voucher-redemption or card-conversion series in these sources.
xrp_impact_assessment.conclusion: Institutional stablecoin distribution/custody has expanded, but the reviewed announcements do not quantify XRP buying, XRP collateral utilization, or market demand.

counter_hypotheses: RLUSD activity on XRPL could increase network activity and marginal XRP fee/bridge use, but no transaction-path or volume evidence here quantifies material demand.
RLUSD on Base/Ethereum and Circle USDC on Arc could route activity away from XRPL; stablecoin adoption can complement or compete with XRP.
SBI voucher, shareholder and reward-card channels could produce retail XRP acquisition, but redemption and conversion totals are undisclosed.
BNY and Standard Chartered custody capabilities could enable institutional XRP holdings, but no client balances are disclosed.
Stablecoin infrastructure growth may benefit payment rails broadly without creating directional XRP demand.
disconfirming_evidence: Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral was future at the October 28 launch.
Standard Chartered/LMAX collateral integration remains planned and approval-dependent.
Ripple National Trust Bank final approval is issuer-reported; a direct OCC final notice was not located in the reviewed official records.
BNY custody support does not disclose actual XRP or RLUSD balances.
SBI XRP voucher and reward announcements disclose no aggregate redemption or XRP acquisition volume.
Alpha Finance reports $0 daily XRP ETF net flow on November 6 despite positive 7-session and 30-session totals.
Circle USDC market share declined from 29% to 27% year-over-year despite average circulation growth.

model_admission.reason: Company announcements, SEC issuer filings, regulator releases and one secondary ETF dashboard are event/corporate context, not synchronized point-in-time XRP market features. Raw HTTP bytes, custody balances, executed flows and chain-level XRP demand are absent.
model_admission.permitted_use: Timestamped event timeline, relationship graph, source disagreement and hypothesis context only.
